News continues to come from Frank Halls who is wounded and a prisoner in Italy, and Arthur Beales, a prisoner in Germany. News also continues to flow in from all parts of the world of our walkers in the Services.

Alf Miller and Arthur Beales were at Stalagluft III at Sagan and were both in good health. Frank Halls was at Stalag 344 at Lansdorf, and his latest news was that his leg was making progress and that he was in good health.
Alec and Dan Patience are now out of the Army and will be turning up on the Common. Frank Halls reports progress with his leg, Arthur Beales' chief trouble is indigestion.

Africa; brother Alec has also been wounded but has returned to his unit---Arthur Beales is missing from air operations over Germany---Tommy Clinton (Irish Guards) writes from hospital that he was wounded just before last Christmas whilst on a landing trip.

ARTHUR BEALES seems to have settled down to life in a prison camp and has "made himself at home"---if such a phrase applies!. FRANK HALLS was wounded in the legs before capture and it is feared that he will not beable to race walk again.
